# Gate 3 master comparison (generated; do not edit by hand)

Protocol v1 `58e59c0` (tag protocol-v1), target T1-v1 (charge decisions at informative stations; primary set with gaze). Mean over 20 repeats of 5-fold participant-grouped nested CV; CIs are participant-level bootstrap (2,000). Operating points A (maximise balanced accuracy) and B (largest threshold with recall >= 0.80) are fixed on the inner validation predictions of each training fold. False-safe = 1 - recall; false-warning = 1 - specificity.
